title: Abel's Cool Modpack!
description: A lightweight, performance-first Fabric pack for MC 26.1.2 - Sodium-powered FPS, Iris shaders, voice chat, and quality-of-life extras. Smooth, social, no bloat.
body:
# Abel's Cool Modpack

A lightweight, performance-first Fabric pack for **Minecraft 26.1.2**. Built to make the game run buttery-smooth while still looking great, with just enough quality-of-life and social features to keep things fun — no bloat, no kitchen-sink chaos.

---

## ⚡ Performance
Powered by the **CaffeineMC** stack — Sodium, Lithium, and Sodium Extra — plus FerriteCore and ImmediatelyFast to slash memory use and crush frame drops. Big FPS gains even on modest hardware. **Reese's Sodium Options** adds a cleaner, more flexible video settings menu on top.

## 🎨 Visuals
**Iris Shaders** is built in, so your favorite shaderpacks work right out of the box. **Gamma Utils** throws in a proper fullbright toggle for those pitch-black caves.

## 🎙️ Multiplayer & Social
- **Simple Voice Chat** — proximity voice on any server
- **Talk Balloons** — chat messages pop up above players' heads
- **Essential Mod** — friends, cosmetics, and easy world-hosting with your buddies

## 🛠️ Quality of Life
- **Mod Menu** — manage everything in-game
- **Resourcify** — browse & install resource/shader packs without leaving Minecraft
- **uku's Armor HUD** — clean armor & durability display
- **Leave My Bars Alone** — declutter your HUD
- **Melody** — menu music
- **Epic Force-Close Loading Screen** — no more stuck loading screens

## 🔧 Under the Hood
Fabric API • Fabric Language Kotlin • Forge Config API Port • Puzzles Lib • Text Placeholder API • ukulib • Modify Player Data — the libraries keeping it all glued together.

---

## 📦 Installation

1. **Install Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 26.1.2 - grab it from [fabricmc.net](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/).
2. **Download the pack** using the Modrinth App (easiest) or your launcher of choice.
   - *Modrinth App:* hit **Install** at the top of this page and you're done.
   - *Manual:* drop the mods into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
3. **Allocate 4GB+ RAM** in your launcher for the smoothest ride.
4. Launch with the **Fabric** profile and enjoy!

> 💡 Running shaders? Open **Video Settings → Shader Packs** (via Iris) and load your pack there.

---

**Requires:** Fabric Loader • Minecraft 26.1.2 • 4GB+ allocated RAM recommended
